subject: [PATCH v2 0/2] mm: refactor zonelist constructors and iterators

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch refactors the zonelist constructors and iterators in the Linux kernel to make them more flexible and modular. The existing behavior of picking nodes from N_MEMORY is made explicit, allowing callers to narrow the set of nodes used for fallback lists. A new function find_next_best_node_in() takes a candidate set as an argument, making it easier to build zonelists over specific sets of nodes. Additionally, the per-node construction loop in build_zonelists() is extracted into a separate function build_node_zonelist(), which can be parameterized on the candidate nodemask and destination zonelist index. These changes enable more flexible and efficient management of zonelists, particularly for generating private node zonelists.
